zh-CN.title: 漫画气泡全面重绘
items: 漫画语音、文件、定位与卡片拥有统一的新视觉

en.title: Comic bubbles, fully redrawn
items: Comic audio, files, locations, and cards now share one visual language
The bubble preview is now a compact, internally scrolling window
Sending media and files now show a clearer sweep effect
